entities.summary: Marko Anttila is a retired Finnish professional ice hockey forward. Anttila was selected by Chicago Blackhawks in the 9th round of the 2004 NHL Entry Draft. His nickname among his teammates is "Stretch", which was given to him by Steve Kariya due to his large physical stature, but among the Finnish fans, he is more commonly known as "Mörkö".
